title: A intersection B
description:
Given the sets `A = {19, 22, 24, 20, 25, 26}` and `B = {19, 22, 20, 25, 26, 24, 28, 27}`: Find A intersection B.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as `intersection(a, b)`, returning a SORTED list of the elements common to both sets.
hints: The intersection of two sets keeps only the elements that appear in both - everything unique to one side is dropped.
Python has both an operator and a method name for this operation.
Use the & operator (or a.intersection(b)) to get the common elements, then return sorted(result).
expected_behavior: Returns a sorted list of the elements that appear in both a and b.
solution:
def intersection(a, b):
    return sorted(a & b)
explanation: The & operator (equivalently, .intersection()) returns a new set with only the elements shared by both operands. Sorting the result gives a predictable order for checking.
